verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents MFA implementation for end users (appwrite-docs-4) and supports 30+ OAuth/social providers (appwrite-docs-1, appwrite-docs-26, appwrite-docs-45), but there is no evidence of enterprise SSO via SAML or OIDC protocols specifically, nor any mention of an org/admin-level policy to 'require' MFA or SSO across an application's users. missing for 10: SAML/OIDC enterprise SSO support, admin-enforced MFA/SSO policy enforcement, independent corroboration of these features working.
